{{Quote|I call on Jedi for judgment.|A Barabel, whose species had deep respect for the Jedi, calling the help of Jedi [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] during a dispute with a Rodian|<ref name="dfr">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>}}
'''902 before the Battle of Yavin (BBY)''' was a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] in the era known as the [[Great Peace of the Republic]]. The [[Time/Legends|time]] period began nearly [[1000 BBY/Legends|one hundred years earlier]] and featured the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] settlement into previously unexplored regions of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Around 902 BBY, the millennia-long [[Barabel War]], a [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] conflict for [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] grounds, escalated to the entire [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] population of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]]. The intervention of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Noga-ta]] brought an end to the dispute.

==Proem==
Around [[4500 BBY]],<ref name="new-alien">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> stemming from a dispute over prime [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] grounds, a [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] civil conflict<ref name="gaw">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> known as the [[Barabel War]]<ref name="dark force" /> erupted on [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The war continued for millennia,<ref name="gaw" /> until a peace agreement was settled by passing [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], around 902 BBY.<ref name="tcswe-noga" /> In [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the [[New Sith Wars]], fought between the Jedi and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], came to an end. Then-current [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]] reorganized the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] through the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]],<ref name="ATLAS">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] became a branch of the Republic [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]].<ref name="nec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==The galaxy in 902 BBY==
The year 902 BBY was also known as 2,751 after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] (ATC),<ref name="YearTC" /> a peace agreement that brought an end to the [[Great Galactic War]] in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="ATLAS" /> 902 BBY was also the same as 98 years after the Ruusan Reformation,<ref name="YearRuu" /> and 867 before the [[Great ReSynchronization]] (BrS), a year-notation system established in [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]].<ref name="YearGrS" /> By 902 BBY, the [[Great Peace of the Republic]], the era that began with the Ruusan Reformation, was nearly one hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] in the making.<ref name="tcswe-era">{{CSWECite|I|363|Great Peace of the Republic}}</ref> The Republic expanded further into the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] and unexplored [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] regions that were later reorganized into the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="ATLAS" />

Around 902 BBY, in the final stages of the Barabel War, the population of Barab I was divided into two opposing camps,<ref name="gg4">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref> supporting the hunters<ref name="dark force" /> of two of the larger clans disputing the rights of access to certain choice hunting grounds.<ref name="geonosis">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref><ref name="anthology">''[[Alien Anthology]]''</ref> The disagreement threatened to erupt into full-scale butchery,<ref name="planet">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> as the entire species was destined to join the coming battle.<ref name="dark force" /> The clans formed two [[Army/Legends|armies]] that were each bent on the ultimate destruction of their enemies, but before the final battle,<ref name="new-alien" /> a group of passing [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] intervened.<ref name="dark force" /> The Jedi, including the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Exploration Corps/Legends|Jedi explorer]] [[Noga-ta]],<ref name="gaw" /> listened to both sides and passed a fair judgment.<ref name="dark force" /> In accordance the Jedi decree, clans always had to share hunting grounds, and a clan's largest kill of the night had to be given to the head of another clan.<ref name="geonosis" /> They settled a peace agreement that ended the Barabel War.<ref name="tcswe-noga" />

==Impact==
The Republic continued its expansion, and the Great Peace of the Republic lasted for nearly [[22 BBY/Legends|nine hundred more years]]. Later in the era, [[Galactic economy|economic forces]] began to shape the Republic, as companies bought [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] to establish the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].<ref name="nec" /> The Jedi explorers did not record Barab I in the galactic registry, so the planet remained uncharted, until the [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] of [[Planetary Safaris Inc.]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] corporation organizing exotic hunting expeditions, discovered the Barabels.<ref name="planet" />

The Barabels never forgot the Jedi decree and never again fought over hunting territory.<ref name="geonosis" /> They developed a rich mythology around the "great warriors from beyond the clouds,"<ref name="anthology" /> although the different stories sometimes mentioned a band of Jedi, sometimes a single Jedi with companions. Noga-ta was immortalized on pots<ref name="geonosis" /> and wall carvings that were discovered by researchers hundreds of years later,<ref name="tcswe-noga" /> although some Barabels&mdash;who believed that outsider's meddling into the sacred past would rouse the spirits of the [[Death/Legends|dead]]&mdash;made their efforts much harder.<ref name="geonosis" />

When the first Imperial scouts arrived at the planet, the Barabels treated them with respect, believing the Jedi heroes of their legends had returned "from beyond the clouds."<ref name="anthology" /><ref name="geonosis" /> During the reign of the Galactic Empire, even in face of persecution, many Barabels refused to denounce the Jedi or [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. They referred to the legend of the Barabel War,<ref name="dark force" /> when the Jedi stopped a thousand years of slaughter.<ref name="gaw" /> From that event onward, the Barabels had a deep respect for the Jedi<ref name="dark force" /> and accepted the judgment of a Jedi in any dispute great or small.<ref name="planet" />

==Notable events==
*Around 902 BBY, Jedi explorer Noga-ta ended the Barabel War by settling a peace agreement over hunting grounds. {{Circa}}<ref name="tcswe-noga" />

==Behind the scenes==
The year 902 BBY was only indirectly mentioned in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which stated that Noga-ta settled the dispute among the Barabels "about 900 years before the Galactic Civil War."<ref name="tcswe-noga" /> Since the Galactic Civil War began in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="nec" /> this article treats this description as the basis for the year. The end of the Barabel war had been mentioned in various earlier source materials describing the Barabels, but these sources provided no exact time frame for the event. In [[2006]], ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' was the first to provide a date for the event by stating that a civil war erupted on Barab I around [[4500 BBY]], and Jedi "mediated a truce that is never broken."<ref name="new-alien" /> However, in [[2008]], ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' placed the event around 902 BBY. In [[2009]], the ''[[Galaxy at War]]'' [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook solved the discrepancy by stating that the civil war lasted for millennia and was settled "centuries before the Empire."<ref name="gaw" />
